records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: First Semester
records.description: Fundamentals of speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Not open to native speakers except with permission.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Second Semester
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 101 with a grade of C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 2 or higher.
records.description: Continuation of CHINESE 101. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Elementary Conversation
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 101 or concurrent enrollment, or CHINESE 102 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Elementary-level conversation practice in small groups with a native/near-native speaker. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Asian Film
records.description: Asian film from a cultural perspective. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 111, ASIA 111, JAPANESE 111.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Traditional Chinese Culture
records.description: Cultural development of China from early times through the golden age of Chinese civilization. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 120, ASIA 120, HUMANITY 120.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Modern Chinese Culture
records.description: An introduction to the culture of modern China, including Hong Kong and Taiwan. All readings in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 121, ASIA 121.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Masterpieces of Asian Literature
records.description: Introduction to Asian literature. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 131, ASIA 131, HUMANITY 131, JAPANESE 131.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Third Semester
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 102 with a grade of C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 3 or higher.
records.description: Further development of speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Fourth Semester
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 203 with a grade of C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 5 or higher.
records.description: Continued practice in spoken and written language; selected texts in a cultural context. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Intermediate Conversation I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 203 or concurrent enrollment, or CHINESE 204 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Intermediate-level conversation practice in small groups with a native/near-native speaker. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Chinese for the Professions
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  CHINESE 203 with a grade of C or better.
records.description: Profession-specific language skills training - healthcare, law enforcement, business - with emphasis on speaking and listening. Not open to native speakers except with permission.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Intermediate Conversation II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 204 or a 300-level CHINESE course or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Conversation practice in small groups. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Intermediate Reading and Translation
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 204 with a C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 5 or higher.
records.description: English-Chinese expressions, development of skills to increase reading speed and fluency.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Intermediate Speaking and Listening
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 204 with a C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 5 or higher.
records.description: Early advanced training in speaking, reading and writing on abstract topics in Chinese; continued development of listening comprehension skills. Taught in Chinese.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Intermediate Grammar and Writing
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 204 with a C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 5 or higher.
records.description: Writing practice in the language and active review of grammar. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Studies in East Asian Film
records.description: Variable content seminar. In-depth study of East Asian cinema that brings together the analysis of cinematography, cultural, and sociopolitical backgrounds, and the impact and influences within an international context. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 311, JAPANESE 311, ASIA 311.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Issues in East Asian Ethics
records.description: Philosophical foundations of ethical thought in East Asia; informed responses to modern ethical dilemmas. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as JAPANESE 320, ASIA 320, CHINESE 320, HUMANITY 320.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Gender and Love in East Asian Culture
records.description: The theme of gender with respect to love, courage, self-sacrifice, and vulnerability in traditional Chinese and Japanese literature and culture. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 321, ASIA 321, JAPANESE 321.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Ecology in East Asian Cultures
records.description: Major ecological issues in East Asia through cultural representations, and analysis of their implications to the U.S. (Crosslisted course offered as ASIA 322, CHINESE 322, HUMANITY 322, JAPANESE 322.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: The Art of War
records.description: The philosophy behind war, military strategy and its consequences and representation in literature and film from East Asia. Taught in English. (Crosslisted course offered as CHINESE 330, ASIA 330.)

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Advanced Chinese for the Professions
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 306, 307, or 308 with a C or better.
records.description: Communication in Chinese in the professional setting; telephone and meeting role play, letter writing, television and discussion of current events. Not open to native speakers except with permission.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Introduction to Literary Chinese
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 306, 307, or 308 with a C or better.
records.description: Fundamentals of literary Chinese. Open to native speakers.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Media Chinese
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHINESE 306, 307, or 308 with a C or better.
records.description: Study of Chinese using newspapers, television news, radio broadcasts, webcasts and other journalistic media. Taught in Chinese. Not open to native speakers except with permission.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Advanced Conversation
records.description: Advanced-level conversation practice in small groups with a native speaker.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Seminar in Chinese Studies - Themes
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Two CHINESE 300-level courses excluding CHINESE 305.
records.description: Seminar on important themes in Chinese studies. Taught in Chinese.

records.subject: CHINESE
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
